t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The main idea is to focus on the colour of the gnomes. specific colours lead to different either to the bright forest or the dark forest. The number of mushrooms changes so aim for ones that can bring the highest ones. Other gnome details outside of colour are irrelevent.

vb_textbox.text: Each gnome comes in pairs of fixed colour. The fixed pairs are orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow and finally blue and purple. Their positions may be on left or right but will always come in pairs.Orange, green, red and blue gnomes take you to the bright forest with red basket. Brown, pink, yellow and purple take you to the dark forest with the yellow basket.The number of mushrooms of each forest varies but one side of the forest will be higher. Stay with that higher side under it starts to run low then switch to the other forest using the colour of the gnomes to take you to the bright of dark forest.Other details of the gnome are irrelevant. Only focus on the colour of the gnome.
